titles.romaji: Nanatsu no Taizai: Ensa no Edinburgh - Kouhen
titles.english: The Seven Deadly Sins: Grudge of Edinburgh Part 2
titles.native: 七つの大罪 怨嗟のエジンバラ 後編

description:
The second half of The Seven Deadly Sins: Grudge of Edinburgh.

Reunited with Lancelot for the first time since their tragic accident, Tristan must learn to conquer his inner demons in order to save his mother's life.

(Source: Netflix)
